method: Compared live API values (elgu_sample_audit.json) field-by-field against revenue_fees.json source text

results.evidence: 20/20 ranges exact; top 6,500,000+ amount 26812 rate 0.004125 for_excess=1
4 options: commercial_industrial_dev_banks 330, rural_thrift_savings_banks 220, universal_banks_insurance 220, pawnshops_money_shops_lending 440 (multiplier must be code-style, labels converted)
in_excess_of 30000, for_every 5000, amount 15 — Gross Excess has no rate field; note this duplicates S3A01-1C source on a separate SAMPLE record
amount 50.00 correct; 'per dog' quantity semantics not encoded (Quantity type would encode it, as in S3G01)
7 sqm tiers 100/150/200/250/300/400/500 exact; excludes 'House for rent: 200' flat which needs its own fee/option
amount 420.00 matches Manufacturers <=100 sq.m tier only; Fixed Amount does not encode sq.m/month/establishment-type — full 5B.01 needs Other Range per establishment type or Options
amount 50.00 = 'Other purposes: 50.00 PHP'; other purposes in 4H.01 (passport 75, firearm 100...) would be separate Fixed Fees or Options
amount 25.00 correct; 'per dog' semantics not encoded

fee_types_not_covered.type: Capital Rate / Capital Excess / Other Excess
fee_types_not_covered.reason: Multiplier variants of Gross Rate/Excess; no ordinance fee in revenue_fees.json is capital-based except 3A.01(1) which is covered via Capital Range + Gross Excess
Only BASIC sampled on Other Fees page; these reveal extra fields (percentage, column_property, ranges) and should be sampled before mass entry if any ordinance fee is assigned there

automation_lessons: Calculation creation auto-creates a placeholder detail (0-1000 / 'option' / 'quantity'); edit it, do not just Add
Update/edit forms: masked amount (₱) and code fields only save with real keyboard typing (pressSequentially); locator.fill/native setter silently reverts to 0 on edit forms
Options/Other Range calculations require Multiplier code (bank_type, sqm) at calculation creation, which becomes the label (Bank Type, Sqm Range)
Options detail multiplier must be code-style (rural_thrift_savings_banks), not the display label
